second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 10 + Average 5 + Difficulty 6 = 21), pdf 92; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-21 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-5, II 6-9, III 10-15, IV 16-17, V 18-20, q21 own header). Answer side: one instruction key for I (label 1 only), keys 6-20 by number ('13 and 14' printed as one key), and q21's key printed as a second '20.'. BLUE PRINT 10/5/6 = 21 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 21.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 92 (heading, LO 13, BLUE PRINT, q1-4) 93 (q5-13) 94 (q13 options-21). A side 'KeyAnswers Lesson 24 Map' pdf 127 (between Lesson 23's last key and Lesson 25's keys). Folios = pdf page.

ANSWER SIDE (analysed first): I prints a single instruction '1.as per your classroom direction' -> q1 stores it as a text answer + 'match key not in pair form'; q2-q5 empty + 'no answer printed' only (gate rule 1.6-a2: an unprinted match key carries its defect flag alone; the section key applies to every row and is named in the flag, not copied). II-V keyed by number. '13 and 14 as per the directions' is one key for two MCQs whose answer depends on the locality -> option null + 'key text not among options' on both. q21's key is printed as a second '20.' ('Students draw the picture:-').

MAP (Class-9 rulings): no map is printed on either side of this lesson. q21 'Draw a map of your school to home and colour it.' is a sourceless draw-map question -> empty + 'no answer printed' (no map block, no crop), as evs-4-12 q48. Section I matches classroom objects to directions (no map).

Sections: s1 I match q1-5 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s2 II q6-9 (one sentence each -> vsa); s3 III mcq q10-15 (q10-12 and q15 print three options -> 'source notation inconsistent'; text-only keys: q10 'Map' -> A pass 1, q11 'Blue' -> C 'Light blue' pass 2; q12 'Directions' vs option 'Direction' and q15 'Cross' vs 'Pluse (+)' match no option -> null + 'key text not among options' with the suggested letter); s4 IV fill q16-17; s5 V T/F q18-20; s6 q21.
MARKS (R-E9, rev 3): all six headers' N equals the printed count -> s1 1, s2 1, s3 1, s4 1, s5 1; s6 '3x1=3' over q21 alone -> null.
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 21 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 13, lo_source 'lesson_table'.
FIGURES: none on these pages. TOPIC evs-3-24-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
